richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mizoram

c: In Mizoram, flat land is the scarce resource. Aizawl and most towns are built along steep ridges. An outdoor gym often has to fit on a narrow terrace, a roadside strip or the edge of a church or school compound. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness machines for exactly these sites, with layouts drawn around the space you actually have. Lunglei and Champhai have the same ridge-top layout, so the same planning approach applies there.

We build the equipment at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, and send it to Mizoram by road. Our installation team or a local dealer fixes each station, grouted into concrete or self-standing on a prepared base. Buyers are mostly local councils, churches, schools, colleges and government departments. Many want a small set of machines first and more later, which works well because each station has its own base. Local football grounds are another good site, since players already gather there for training.

richText.heading: Making the most of a narrow hill site

each give two exercises on one frame. Place swinging machines away from the edge of a slope, and add a railing where the terrace drops away. Keep the main walking path clear so people can pass the stations safely.

facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What is the smallest outdoor gym you can plan?
items.a: Even two or three stations make a useful start. Send us the length and width of your terrace or strip, and we will suggest compact or combination machines that fit with safe clear space.

items.q: Is a grouted or self-standing base better on a slope?
items.a: On sloping ground a grouted base is usually firmer, provided water can drain away behind it. Our team or dealer checks the site and confirms the method before installation.

items.q: Can a church or local council order directly from FunPlay?
items.a: Yes. Write to sales@funplaysystems.com or call +91 902 830 2266 with photos and measurements. We reply with suggested machines, a layout drawing and a quote.
